# LNJC Insights

> Well-sourced articles on pharmaceutical and medical-supply distribution in Yemen, published by LNJC Pharmaceuticals and Medical Supplies Co., Ltd., a licensed importer and distributor in the Republic of Yemen, and exclusive distributor in the Republic of Yemen, under signed agreements and for the products named in those agreements, for Shivani Scientific and BOKANG BIO. Topics: medical-supply quality, cold chain, IVF/ART laboratory set-up, and market entry. Every statistic in these articles is cited to a named authoritative source (WHO, PAHO, UN OCHA, World Bank, ESHRE/ICMART, and peer-reviewed journals).

## About LNJC
- Licensed importer and distributor of pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, laboratory equipment and pharmaceutical raw materials in the Republic of Yemen.
- Exclusive distributor in Yemen, under signed agreements, for named products of Shivani Scientific (India) and BOKANG BIO (China).
- Contact: +967 775 559 781 · contact@landcarenj.com · https://landcarenj.com/

## Articles (English, for international manufacturers)
- [Entering the Yemen market: a manufacturer's guide to distribution](https://blog.landcarenj.com/en/entering-the-yemen-market.html): Market need, import dependence (~80 to 90% of medicines imported), registration, cold chain, and why a local distribution partner matters. Sources: World Bank, UN OCHA (2026), Alshakka et al. (2021), WHO/PAHO.
- [Choosing a distribution partner in Yemen: what to look for](https://blog.landcarenj.com/en/choosing-a-distribution-partner.html): Why quality is the first question (WHO: ~1 in 10 medical products in low/middle-income countries is substandard or falsified), licensing, registration, cold chain, support and exclusivity. Sources: WHO (2017, 2024), Vaccine (2007).
- [Air quality in the IVF laboratory: what the numbers mean](https://blog.landcarenj.com/en/ivf-lab-air-quality.html): VOC limits, particle counts and cleanliness grades for embryology laboratories, the evidence linking laboratory air quality to fertilisation and pregnancy rates, and what to check when specifying equipment.
- [How medical products are cleared for import: the controls and the paperwork](https://blog.landcarenj.com/en/import-controls-and-clearance.html): Who may import, the legal basis for national import controls, the documents customs expects, and how a suspect consignment is handled. Source: WHO Technical Report Series No. 1019, Annex 5 (2019).
- [Who may import medical products, and what a local representative is for](https://blog.landcarenj.com/en/authorised-importer-and-local-agent.html): Authorised importers, permits issued to a local agent where no formal marketing authorisation system exists, and the supplier and customer due diligence GDP guidelines expect from a distribution partner. Sources: WHO Technical Report Series No. 1019, Annex 5 (2019); EU Good Distribution Practice guidelines 2013/C 343/01, sections 5.2 to 5.3.
- [Importing pharmaceutical starting materials and active ingredients](https://blog.landcarenj.com/en/importing-starting-materials.html): Who is responsible for the quality of APIs and excipients, where authorities check them at the border, and what documents, a manufacturer's warranty and a certificate of analysis, should accompany a consignment. Source: WHO Technical Report Series No. 1019, Annex 5 (2019).

## Articles (Arabic, for the Yemeni market)
- [كيف تختار موردًا موثوقًا للمستلزمات الطبية في اليمن](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/choosing-medical-supplies-distributor.html): A six-point buyer's guide to selecting a reliable medical-supplies distributor, licensing, quality, cold chain, continuity, technical support. Sources: WHO, WHO/PAHO.
- [سلسلة التبريد: كيف تُحفظ الأدوية واللقاحات أثناء النقل والتخزين](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/cold-chain-handling.html): Cold-chain guide, temperature ranges (2 to 8°C), evidence that excursions are common (14 to 35% of fridges/shipments froze vaccines) and that potency loss is cumulative and not reversed by re-cooling. Sources: WHO/PAHO, Vaccine (2007).
- [ما الذي تحتاجه مختبرات أطفال الأنابيب من تجهيزات؟](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/ivf-lab-equipment.html): IVF/ART laboratory set-up, infertility prevalence (WHO 2023: ~1 in 6), why lab air quality affects outcomes, and core equipment categories. Sources: WHO (2023), J Assist Reprod Genet (2017), ESHRE/Human Reproduction (2008).
- [الانحراف الحراري: ماذا تسجل وماذا تفعل](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/temperature-excursion.html): What to do when a shipment or refrigerator leaves its temperature range, quarantine and label rather than discard or use, what to record, and who decides the disposition. Sources: WHO TRS 961 Annex 9 (2011), WHO TRS 1025 Annex 7 (2020), CDC Pink Book Ch. 5, CDC Vaccine Storage and Handling Toolkit (2026).
- [تاريخ إعادة الفحص وتاريخ الانتهاء للمادة الفعالة: ما الفرق؟](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/api-retest-vs-expiry.html): Retest date versus expiry date for active pharmaceutical ingredients under ICH and WHO, and why raw materials are handled differently from finished products.
- [ما الذي تخبرك به شهادة التحليل فعليا، وما لا تخبرك به](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/coa-what-it-tells-you.html): What a Certificate of Analysis is obliged to document under ICH Q7, USP and WHO, what it does not guarantee, documented falsification risk, and how an importer verifies one before acceptance.
- [مسار تسجيل المنتج الطبي لدى الجهات المختصة في اليمن](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/yemen-product-registration.html): Which authority registers medicines and medical devices in Yemen, the role of the local agent, and the core documents a registration dossier requires.
- [الذيفانات الداخلية: لماذا تبقى بعد التعقيم](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/endotoxins-after-sterilization.html): Why sterilisation does not remove bacterial endotoxins, the USP <85> bacterial endotoxins test, and the shift from LAL to recombinant Factor C. Sources: FDA, USP, EDQM.
- [تأهيل المستودع الدوائي ورسم الخريطة الحرارية](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/warehouse-temperature-mapping.html): How a pharmaceutical warehouse temperature mapping study is run: how many data loggers and where to place them, study duration, the seasonal repeat, door-opening and power-failure tests, and when mapping must be redone.
- [ما الأوراق التي يجب أن ترافق كل شحنة دوائية؟](https://blog.landcarenj.com/ar/shipment-documents.html): The documents that should accompany every medicine consignment, batch-release certificate, mandatory invoice data, receipt inspection, and certificate of analysis for starting materials. Sources: WHO Technical Report Series No. 1019, Annex 5 (2019); EU Good Distribution Practice guidelines 2013/C 343/01, section 5.4.
